reason: This plugin is classified as a data-processing utility because its primary user-facing purpose is to capture DSH Web model usage data, compute estimated token-based costs, and present those results in interactive views for sessions, models, and days. While it adds UI and persistence features, its core function is local cost tracking and cost-reporting rather than code generation, automation, or external service orchestration.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Web 提供花费统计功能，自动记录模型调用用量并按会话、模型和日期展示估算花费。
summaries.en: This plugin adds cost tracking to DSH Web by recording model call usage and displaying estimated spend by session, model, and date.

capabilities: Tracks model call token usage and estimates cost
Displays cost summaries by session/model/day in a web panel
Persists usage and pricing data in local storage

reasons.code: README states the plugin automatically records each model call’s usage and supports viewing by session, model, and day.
README details dashboard sections for overview, by model, by session, and recent calls, indicating processing and presentation of computed cost data.
README notes local data storage at ~/.dsh/cost-tracker.json and that pricing updates trigger reprocessing of historical records.
package.json declares a DSH web bundle/client entry and plugin-facing manifests, confirming this is a web-integrated utility extension.
Repository tree includes lib/index.js and lib/client.js, matching host-side tracking plus browser-side UI components.
